headline: No direct interaction pathway is documented; residual risks are low and mostly blocked by both agents' no-network, no-filesystem profiles.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel is documented between awesome-nlp and LightZero. Agent A is non-runnable with network_egress none, and agent B has no filesystem, MCP, browser, or subprocess surfaces, so there is no plausible default path for A's outputs to reach B as instructions.
conditions: IF an external orchestrator copies A's text into B's prompt, injection becomes possible.
IF a shared clipboard or message queue is introduced, the pathway changes.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no shared prompt bus.
Disable any copy-paste automation between outputs and inputs.
Review orchestrator wiring for hidden shared channels.
requires-engineering: add provenance tags if a bridge is later introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither profile shows sensitive data classes, and both agents have network_egress none. Agent B cannot read_filesystem or write_filesystem, and agent A is non-runnable, so there is no documented path for shared workspace leakage or backend exfiltration in the default pair.
conditions: IF either agent is later connected to a shared workspace containing secrets, leakage risk increases.
IF an external wrapper forwards file contents into either model, the profile assumptions no longer hold.
mitigations: Do not mount a shared workspace.
Keep secrets out of any copied prompts.
Verify both agents remain network-isolated.
requires-engineering: add DLP controls if shared storage is introduced.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: There is no overlapping write surface to conflict over. Agent B explicitly cannot write_filesystem or modify_git_state, and agent A is non-runnable with no declared write or network capabilities, so the pair cannot contend for shared mutable resources in the documented configuration.
conditions: IF an orchestrator grants B write access to a shared directory, conflict risk appears.
IF A is wrapped in a runtime that adds mutable state, the analysis changes.
mitigations: Keep B read-only as profiled.
Avoid shared git or workspace mounts.
Do not add write permissions without coordination.
requires-engineering: introduce locking if mutable shared state is later enabled.

D_cascading_error.rationale: B cannot act on A's outputs because B has no write, shell, browser, subprocess, or MCP capabilities, and A is not runnable. Without downstream action-taking authority or a documented input chain, there is no plausible cascade from A's output to B's actions.
conditions: IF B is later connected to an action-taking toolchain, A's outputs could become authoritative inputs.
IF an operator manually forwards A's text into a workflow engine, cascade risk changes.
mitigations: Keep B as a non-actioning component.
Require human review before any downstream use of A's output.
Do not connect either agent to automation hooks.
requires-engineering: add verification gates before any future action execution.

E_compliance.rationale: No compliance-sensitive data classes, residency constraints, or retention policies are documented for either awesome-nlp or LightZero. With both profiles showing docs-only evidence and no touched data classes, there is no specific compliance mismatch to assess.
conditions: IF either agent is later used on regulated data, a compliance review is required.
IF residency or retention policies are added to either profile, reassess the pair.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair.
Document any future residency or retention requirements.
Re-run review if PHI, EU PII, or secrets are introduced.
requires-engineering: add policy enforcement if regulated data becomes in scope.
